$comment: FORM P4-T4 retroactive admission record (the slot predates the budget, so it is also in baselineSlots; this record documents why it earned its place). Probe, apps and teaching line written and checked against the files on 2026-11-17.

declarative.why: says what a third party may send (event name, field mapping, idempotency key, signature scheme); no ordering, no logic

notLower.why: an unauthenticated public route that verifies a signature and publishes into the flow engine can only be provided and secured by the platform; a function or flow cannot open a door

taught.bundleLine: A third party that calls you (a payment confirmation) needs an inbound door: a capability entry {"name":"payment-processor","inbound":{"eventName":"PaymentConfirmed",...}} serves POST /api/hooks/payment-processor with no NPDev login.
